# Josh Winningham

> Full-stack software engineer in the Phoenix, AZ area, working remotely. Builds and operates production web products end to end: accounts, payments, integrations, data pipelines, deployment, and maintenance. Founder of Scale Visibility. Open to full-time, contract, or project work.

Primary stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Supabase, Stripe, Vercel. Also C#, ASP.NET Core, Python, Flask, Astro, WordPress, AWS.

## Production products

- [Scale Visibility](https://app.scalevisibility.com/): authenticated AI-search readiness audit platform with saved reports, citation testing, competitor benchmarking, Stripe billing, and six public readiness tools (Next.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Inngest)
- [It's an Art Party](https://www.itsanartparty.com/): multi-city provider directory marketplace with provider self-service, free and sponsored listings, Clerk auth, Stripe billing, and lifecycle email (Next.js, PostgreSQL)
- [TrueTourney](https://www.truetourney.com/): youth sports tournament directory with scheduled data refreshes, director submissions, and registration-click reporting (Next.js, Node.js, Upstash Redis)
